about: Synthetic clinical notes written for Airlock. Every person, place, number and date is invented. `identifiers` lists each string that must never reach the cloud. Notes marked `tuning` were used while writing the detection prompt and pattern backstops; `holdout` notes were written afterwards and never tuned on.
